job.description: Job name to reserve. A template used by several sessions at once shouldn't set one: a job is held by one session at a time.

cwd.description: Absolute, or ~/ followed by a path, expanded against the home directory when the template is loaded.

prompt.description: First prompt. The input's prompt replaces it.

prompt_file.description: Relative to templates/, and inside it. Read when the template is loaded; its contents become prompt.

args.description: Extra claude arguments, placed before the input's.

vars.description: User variables, merged under the input's.

description.description: Free text for people and the templates operation; spawn ignores it.
